label: Lead with offbeats
message: Put the offbeats before the remaining drawn notes.
helper: Lead with offbeats puts the second, fourth and later alternating drawn notes first, then the first, third and remaining notes. It keeps every held seed; choose Drawn to hear the change.
output: offbeats lead the full drawn phrase without losing seeds

label: Swap drawn pairs
message: Swapped each pair of drawn notes.
helper: Swap drawn pairs trades the first two drawn notes, then the next two, and so on. An unpaired last note stays last. The held seeds do not move.
output: drawn pairs exchange order and a second swap restores the phrase

label: Reverse drawn threes
message: Reversed each group of up to three drawn notes.
helper: Reverse drawn threes reverses each group of three notes in drawn order. A final group of one or two reverses too. Apply it twice to restore the path.
output: groups of three reverse with their short tail intact

label: Exchange phrase halves
message: Put the second half before the first half.
helper: Exchange phrase halves cuts the drawn phrase after its middle note, then puts the second half first. With an odd number of notes, the first half gets the extra note. Undo restores the original cut.
output: the second drawn half leads while both halves keep their order

label: Weave ends inward
message: Wove the drawn phrase from both ends inward.
helper: Weave ends inward takes the first drawn note, then the last, then the second and next-to-last, until the two ends meet. It keeps every seed exactly once.
output: both drawn ends weave inward without repeating the middle

label: Weave middle outward
message: Wove the drawn phrase from its middle outward.
helper: Weave middle outward starts at the earlier middle note, then takes one to its right, one to its left, and continues outward. This follows drawn positions, not distance from the garden center.
output: the drawn middle expands outward with every seed retained
